description: NIST's CTC-05 whole: both of its refusals are right — edge #4444 is 0.0182 off a face, a surface body is no solid — and the read took 66 s in a release build and 88 s in the test profile, past ADR-0026 §6's 60 s: pcurve fits on its B-spline faces climbed to the tolerance they needed one miss at a time, each miss a fit of thousands of spans. The reader now measures the curve's farthest distance after the first miss and asks for enough at once, and the read takes 1 s. The whole read is the case
licence: NIST: "The test cases, CAD models, and STEP files can be used without any restrictions."

refused.why: edge #4444 lies 0.0182 from a face it bounds, past the model's max_tolerance of 0.01: closing that is sewing, which is healing (ADR-0025 §4); Open CASCADE carries the part at tolerances of up to 0.086
